Inside Namaste Bookshop · 14th Street, Manhattan

Have your cards read. Then take a deck home.

Namaste Tarot is the tarot side of Namaste Bookshop. Sit with one of the shop's readers for fifteen minutes or a full hour, and browse the decks, pouches and talismans the shop keeps on its shelves.

Book a tarot reading See the decks

A reading

Sessions come in quarter-hour steps, up to a full hour. Most readers start at about $35 for a quarter hour, and you confirm the figure before paying.

How readings work here

A reader

Some readers use the Thoth deck, some add Lenormand or astrology, and some read mostly by intuition. Pick by style.

Where Namaste Tarot lives

There is no separate Namaste Tarot storefront. Readings happen inside the bookshop on West 14th Street, and in the Namaste Healing Center upstairs in the same building. Orders placed here are filled by the bookshop, which ships from New York.
